Subject: Update on your application for the Marketing position

Dear [Candidate Name],

Thank you for taking the time to apply for the Marketing position at [Company Name] and for sharing your background with us. We truly appreciate the effort you put into your application and the interview process.

After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely aligns with the specific needs of this role at this time. Please know that this decision was not made lightly, and we were genuinely impressed by your skills and qualifications.

We will keep your resume on file and encourage you to apply for future openings that may be a better match for your expertise. We wish you the very best in your job search and your future professional endeavors.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Company Name]
